name: US equity stress
summary: VIX closed near 35.9 on 20 Nov, above the 30 Alert line; S&P 500 11.6% below its high after a weekly fall of 6.8%
state: The VIX closed near 35.9 on 20 Nov, up 57% on the week and at its 52-week high, above the 30 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 closed near 6,910, 11.6% below its 52-week high and 6.8% lower on the week, with a worst single day of -3.7% in five sessions. The drawdown is inside the 15% line, so the Alert rests on volatility.
for_you: Share prices are in a stress regime with large daily swings. Pensions and investment accounts with equity exposure are likely to show sharp short-term moves.
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
